entities.name: Joonas Cavén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joonas Ilmari Cavén is a Finnish former professional basketball player who lastly played for the Tampereen Pyrintö of Finland's Korisliiga. He has previously played in Spain for Joventut Badalona of the Liga ACB, but mostly for the club's development team CB Prat of the Spanish third-tier league LEB Plata. He also competes for the Finnish national team as he made his debut in August 2013 against Russia.
